notes.title: Update 0.1.7
Early Release and Future Plans
notes.content:
[h1]Release[/h1]
I'll be brief. Our main goal is to create a large modding community, as it was in Warcraft 3. 
First of all, we will focus on the map editor, with the ability to create various game worlds on the game engine. With minimal programming skills.
In the current version of the game, we have only demonstrated an example of a map (ElementalsFight) made in this editor. In the future, as an editor, it will be brought to a quality level - we will release it for use by the community.

[h1]Current work[/h1]
We are currently working on the first point of our roadmap - creating an RTS component of our game with abilities and construction, with a hero and units. But this is only a small part of what is required from this task. Many visual and game things still need to be completed and added.
In the next patch, it is planned to add an enemy Bot so that you can test your skills before playing with a real player. Also, fix some bugs with pathfinding, animations.
[b]Follow the news.[/b]
